details: President Trump has reportedly agreed to an ethics provision for the Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act, a key US crypto regulation bill. This removes a major roadblock, potentially allowing the bill to be voted on by the Senate before the August recess. The act aims to clarify regulatory oversight, and the ethics clause addresses federal officials' digital asset profits.
title: Trump Agrees to Ethics Provision for CLARITY Act

details: Asset manager Grayscale has filed an S-1 registration statement with the SEC to launch the first US exchange-traded fund (ETF) tied to Worldcoin (WLD). The proposed Grayscale Worldcoin ETF (GWLD) would hold WLD tokens and track their price, leading to an approximate 8% price jump for WLD.
title: Worldcoin (WLD) Jumps 8% on Grayscale ETF Filing

details: Bitcoin mining companies Hut 8 and IREN have announced substantial AI infrastructure contracts, marking a strategic shift towards AI and high-performance computing. Hut 8 secured a $9.8 billion lease, while IREN landed $2.8 billion in cloud services contracts, leading to a rally in AI-focused Bitcoin mining stocks.
title: Bitcoin Miners Hut 8 & IREN Secure Billions in AI Contracts

details: Bitcoin climbed to a two-week high around $65,500, buoyed by five consecutive days of inflows into U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs, totaling over $600 million. This institutional buying spree, the longest since mid-July, coincided with a broader risk rally in the market.
title: Bitcoin Hits Two-Week High Near $65,500 on ETF Inflows

details: Russia's State Duma has passed a comprehensive crypto law, setting a framework for crypto exchanges, digital depositories, and investors. The law aims to create legal conditions for cryptocurrencies, recognizing digital assets as property and clearing them for use in foreign trade under state supervision, though crypto payments in rubles remain banned domestically.
title: Russia Passes Landmark Crypto Law for State-Run Trade

details: Jack Mallers has resigned as CEO of Tether-controlled Twenty One Capital (XXI) to focus on his Bitcoin payments company, Strike. The proposed three-way merger between Twenty One Capital, Strike, and Elektron Energy has been abandoned, with Strike continuing as a standalone entity.
title: Jack Mallers Exits XXI Capital CEO Role, Strike Merger Off

details: Exodus Movement is cutting 25% of its global workforce as part of a strategic pivot towards becoming a full-stack stablecoin payments platform. The company expects to save $10 million to $13 million annually by 2027 through this restructuring.
title: Exodus Cuts 25% Workforce, Shifts to Stablecoin Payments
